title: Are organics worth it? - Harvard Health
summary: Harvard Health post saying organic is better for the planet but not clearly healthier, recommending organic for Dirty Dozen items if affordable, and stressing that eating more produce matters most and organic junk food is still junk.

assertions.quote: Organic foods are clearly healthier for the planet
there isn’t clear evidence that organic foods are also healthier for people
organic foods come at a higher price
focus your food dollars where it matters the most—by avoiding the types of fresh produce most likely to retain pesticide residue
the most important step you can take toward a healthier diet is simply eating more fruits and vegetables, whether they’re organic or not
just because snack foods such as chips and cookies have labels that say organic, that does not equal healthy
